hero.title: work
hero.description: A selection of digital products, interactive experiences and visual identities – built across software, design and physical interaction.
My background started in graphic design and gradually moved into software development, interaction design and creative technology. Today I like working where those disciplines meet.

sqlDeveloper.description: Working on SQL-driven data analysis, database updates and migration-related tasks within a large government IT environment. My work includes writing and validating SQL scripts, analysing DB2 data, testing database changes and supporting application and data migration processes.

applicationTester.description: Started at FPS Finance as an application tester, validating financial applications through functional testing, test scenarios, API testing and database checks before moving into a more SQL-focused development role.

webDeveloperIntern.description: Worked in a development environment where I gained practical experience building and maintaining digital products and translating designs into working web interfaces.

graphicIntern.description: Worked with graphic production, print preparation and visual design. This experience gave me a strong foundation in typography, layout, colour and production-oriented design.

bachelor.description: Continuing my studies while working, with a focus on software development, interactive applications, IoT and creative technology.

graduate.description: A practice-oriented programming programme covering frontend and backend development, databases, APIs and full-stack application development.

secondary.description: Built my visual foundation in graphic design, typography, prepress, print production and digital communication.

toolbox.intro: I work across software, design and physical computing. The tools change depending on the project - the goal stays the same: making something that works and feels considered.

hero.intro: I work across software, interaction design and physical computing, combining technical development with a visual background in design.

intro.title: who I am
intro.text: I started with graphic design and gradually moved into programming, software development and creative technology. That mix still defines how I work today: I care about how something functions, how it looks and how people experience it.

story.title: background
story.paragraph1: My first background was visual. I worked with typography, layout, branding and print production before moving deeper into digital design and development.
story.paragraph2: Programming gave me another way to create. Instead of only designing what something should look like, I could build how it behaves, how data moves through it and how people interact with it.

current.title: today
current.lead: Today my work sits somewhere between software development, database work, interaction design and creative technology.
current.paragraph1: Professionally, I work as an SQL Developer while continuing to build interactive digital and physical projects alongside my studies.
current.paragraph2: I particularly enjoy projects where software connects to the physical world — interfaces, installations, sensors, embedded systems and experiences people can actually touch.

understand.title: understand
understand.text: I start by understanding the problem, the context and what the experience actually needs to achieve.

make.title: make
make.text: I like turning ideas into working prototypes early instead of keeping everything theoretical for too long.

refine.title: refine
refine.text: Once something works, I refine the interaction, visual details and technical structure until the experience feels coherent.

software.title: software
software.text: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, SQL, APIs and backend development.

interaction.title: interaction
interaction.text: UI design, interaction design, prototyping and digital product experiences.

physical.title: physical
physical.text: Raspberry Pi, ESP32, RFID, sensors, LEDs and interactive installations.

visual.title: visual
visual.text: Graphic design, brand identity, typography, layout and visual systems.
